clue.text: Fellow Republican steals books for dealer in exchange

indicators.note: to steal is to take something in, so the fellow and the party letter hold the books

parts.note: Joe is an everyday name for an ordinary fellow
B is short for book, so BB stands for books

explanation.surface: A political fellow pockets some books while making a trade.
explanation.walkthrough: A stock jobber was a dealer on the London Stock Exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: A jobber was a wholesale dealer trading shares on the floor of the Stock Exchange.

clue.text: Take part in some games, last in a series

indicators.note: Take part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An invitation to join in a few games, the final ones of a run.
explanation.definitionFit: The final letter of the Greek alphabet stands for the end of any sequence.

clue.text: Illegal delivery over in major Victorian backwater

indicators.note: in puts the turned-round delivery inside the word for major

parts.note: major means big

indicators.note: over says the cricket term is turned back to front

parts.note: a no-ball is an illegal delivery in cricket, a ball bowled against the rules

explanation.surface: A cricket umpire calls an illegal ball in a big match in Victoria.
explanation.walkthrough: A no-ball is a cricket delivery that breaks the rules. 'Victorian' refers to the Australian state, not the era.
explanation.definitionFit: In Australian English this is a stagnant pool or oxbow cut off from a river.

clue.text: Repeat overture to Patience during broadcast

indicators.note: during places the opening letter within the broadcast word

parts.note: to relay is to broadcast a signal

indicators.note: an overture is the opening, so only the first letter of Patience is used

explanation.surface: The overture to Gilbert and Sullivan's Patience is played again on air.
explanation.definitionFit: A rerun of a match or recording is a repeat of it.

clue.text: Thrash with a fan round front of kisser

indicators.note: round says the fan word wraps around the kisser's front letter

parts.note: a lover of something is a fan of it

indicators.note: front of takes just the opening letter of kisser

explanation.surface: An admirer is given a beating after kissing someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thrash' is a noun here, meaning a one-sided win.
explanation.definitionFit: An easy victory against feeble opposition is both a thrashing and a walkover.

clue.text: Cleaner whips a gun out, initially lifting £1

indicators.note: out signals the letters of whips a gun are scrambled
initially takes the opening letter of lifting

parts.note: one is I and a pound is a quid in British slang

explanation.surface: A cleaner produces a gun and starts lifting a pound.
explanation.walkthrough: A quid is British slang for a pound sterling, and one is I.
explanation.definitionFit: Detergent for cleaning dishes after a meal is a kind of cleaner.

clue.text: Witness stunner performing

parts.note: a looker is an attractive person, a stunner
a performer is on stage

explanation.surface: Someone sees a beautiful person putting on a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectator who watches without taking part is a witness to events.

clue.text: More remote troops steal truck

indicators.note: to steal is to take in, so the troops hold the truck

parts.note: OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers
a ute is a utility truck, an Australian pickup

explanation.surface: Soldiers make off with a pickup somewhere far away.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is military shorthand for other ranks; a ute is an Australian pickup truck.
explanation.definitionFit: Further from the centre is the comparative sense of being remote.

clue.text: Ultimately love timeless portrait: "An Old Voluptuary"

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of love
timeless says a T, the abbreviation for time, is dropped from the picture word

parts.note: a portrait is a picture

explanation.surface: A painting is titled after a pleasure-loving old man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Timeless' drops T from PICTURE, leaving PICURE.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of the ancient philosopher Epicurus came to mean a lover of sensual pleasure, a voluptuary.

clue.text: It depends on stock we'd returned with drink

indicators.note: returned says the joined word is read backwards

parts.note: we'd is a contraction that can be written wed when joined
to lap is to drink as a cat does

explanation.surface: A sentence about livestock depending on a wedding and a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Depends' means hangs down, and 'stock' is cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: The fold of loose skin hanging from a cow's throat dangles from cattle.

clue.text: Harry Smith loves European drink

indicators.note: to harry is to harass, so the letters are disturbed

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so two loves are two Os

explanation.surface: A man named Harry Smith is fond of a continental beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A blended fruit beverage, thick and cold, is a drink.

clue.text: Swimmers trapped in Ocala marina

indicators.note: trapped in says the answer sits within the letters of the place names

explanation.surface: Sea creatures are stuck in a marina in Ocala, Florida.
explanation.definitionFit: Squid, served as rings, are creatures that swim, so swimmers.

clue.text: Lecture from retired Scottish university lecturer

indicators.note: retired says the Scots word for from goes backwards

parts.note: frae is the Scots word for from

explanation.surface: A talking-to from a retired lecturer at a Scottish university.
explanation.definitionFit: A long scolding or reprimand is a lecture given to someone.

clue.text: Nymph appearing just beyond delta

definitions.meaning: in Greek myth a mountain nymph who could only repeat others' words
in the NATO phonetic alphabet the letter after D comes after delta

explanation.surface: A nymph turns up just past a river delta.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical nymph faded until only her voice remained; in radio spelling her name follows delta.

clue.text: Notice women's institute's energy as their hands move?

parts.note: to clock something is to notice it
WI is the Women's Institute, plus its 's
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: The Women's Institute's energy is noticed as members wave their hands.
explanation.walkthrough: The Women's Institute is a British organisation for women's community groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Clock hands turn in this direction, so the question mark points at a timepiece.

clue.text: Greek chose counterfeit note and coin in Vienna

indicators.note: counterfeit means fake, so the letters are made into something false

explanation.surface: A Greek forger picks out fake notes and coins in Vienna.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a small Austrian coin, a hundredth of a schilling.

clue.text: Sound of two queens with an unsated lust primarily

parts.note: a queen is a female cat, and ER is Elizabeth Regina

indicators.note: primarily takes the first letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: Two queens make a noise, driven by an unsatisfied desire.
explanation.definitionFit: The yowl of cats on heat is a harsh sound.

clue.text: Could it be put out by 3?

definitions.text: Could it be put out by 3?

parts.words: Could it be put out by 3?
parts.note: 3 down is an Australian pool of water, which might douse a blaze in the outback

explanation.definitionFit: A wild blaze in Australian scrub could be extinguished with water from a nearby pool.

clue.text: Dragged out Jack with superior redcap for event

parts.note: something dragged out is long
J is the card abbreviation for jack
U means upper class, superior
a redcap is a military policeman, MP

explanation.surface: A long-winded sailor teams up with a superior military policeman for a sports day.
explanation.walkthrough: Redcap is British slang for a military policeman, from their red caps.
explanation.definitionFit: This athletics competition is a field event.

clue.text: Golden koi primarily kept here?

parts.note: tan is a golden-brown colour

indicators.note: primarily takes the first letter of koi

explanation.surface: Golden carp kept somewhere in particular.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass aquarium is where ornamental fish like golden koi are kept.

clue.text: Took a long look and began to forget time

indicators.note: to forget is to lose, so a time letter is dropped

parts.note: started means began

explanation.surface: Someone gazed and started to lose track of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Gazing fixedly for a long while is to have gazed hard.

clue.text: South Korean leaders chase rough

indicators.note: leaders takes the first letter of each of the two words

parts.note: to chase metal is to engrave it, to etch

explanation.surface: South Korean leaders pursuing something rough.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough is a preliminary drawing or draft.

clue.text: Officer brought up to eat uncooked fish

indicators.note: to eat is to take in, so the officer holds the uncooked word
in a down clue brought up reads the officer letters from bottom to top

parts.note: LT is short for lieutenant, an officer
raw means uncooked

explanation.surface: An officer is served raw fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To drag a net through the sea is to fish.

clue.text: Mingle in session 9

parts.note: a term is an academic session
IX is nine in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Socialise during the ninth session.
explanation.definitionFit: Blending things together is to mingle them.

clue.text: It may consist of cards in packs for auditor

indicators.note: an auditor is a listener, so the words are heard

parts.note: packs of cards are decks, so this is in decks

explanation.surface: Cards in packs given to someone checking the accounts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Auditor' is a listener, not an accountant.
explanation.definitionFit: A library catalogue was once a box of reference cards, a card index.

clue.text: Sweet French husband returns wearing shabby suit

indicators.note: wearing puts the husband word inside the suit
shabby means worn out, so the letters are rearranged
returns says the French word reads backwards

parts.note: mari is French for husband

explanation.surface: A Frenchman comes home in a scruffy suit.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian coffee dessert is a sweet.

clue.text: Golfing body controlling wife's place in Africa

indicators.note: controlling means holding, so the golfing body contains the wife's letter

parts.note: the R and A, Royal and Ancient, governs golf
W is short for wife

explanation.surface: Golf's ruling body takes charge of a wife's home in Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: The R&A (Royal and Ancient) of St Andrews governs golf outside North America.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small country in east-central Africa.

clue.text: Learned about appearing in prosperous commercial

indicators.note: appearing in puts the about word inside the others

parts.note: well off, prosperous
an ad is a commercial
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Studied an advertisement for a wealthy firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone erudite and widely educated through books is learned.

clue.text: Rich couple in Paris house liberal earl

indicators.note: to house is to contain, so the couple word holds the liberal letter

parts.note: deux is French for two

explanation.surface: A wealthy French couple house a liberal earl.
explanation.definitionFit: Luxurious and lavish goods are rich and opulent.
